#!/bin/sh
peer_transit=10.20.23.1
peer_endpoint=10.20.12.2
primary_gateway=10.20.23.1
primary_device=enp8s0
endpoint_source=10.20.13.2
state=unknown
while :; do
    if ping -n -I "$primary_device" -c 1 -W 1 "$peer_transit" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        if ! ip -4 route show "$peer_endpoint/32" | grep -F "via $primary_gateway dev $primary_device" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            ip -4 route replace "$peer_endpoint/32" via "$primary_gateway" dev "$primary_device" proto static src "$endpoint_source" metric 10
        fi
        if [ "$state" != healthy ]; then
            printf '%s primary-transit healthy; metric-10 static route active\n' "$(date -Is)"
            state=healthy
        fi
    else
        ip -4 route del "$peer_endpoint/32" via "$primary_gateway" dev "$primary_device" metric 10 2>/dev/null || :
        if [ "$state" != failed ]; then
            printf '%s primary-transit failed; metric-10 static route withdrawn\n' "$(date -Is)"
            state=failed
        fi
    fi
    sleep 1
done
